easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
description:
Cast Great Whale by paying its mana cost.
When Great Whale enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Activate Umbral Mantle by paying {0}, targeting Great Whale.
Cowardice triggers, returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
The ability from step 4 fizzles due to having no valid target.
Repeat.
